description: Find the email addresses YouTube channels publish in plain text on their about page or linked website, with the source of each. Takes channels or a search term with a subscriber range. No login. A channel with no published address is free.

channels.description: Channel URLs, @handles, or UC channel IDs, up to 500 a run. Clay users: wrap a column in a one item list.

check_all_sources.description: no (default) stops at the first source with an address. yes reads them all, which takes longer.

check_websites.description: no (default) or yes. yes reads the home page and one contact or about page on a site the channel links to, obeying robots.txt. It finds more addresses and costs more pages per run.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge would pass this amount.

max_subscribers.description: Optional. Number as text. YouTube rounds subscriber counts, so this filter is approximate.

min_subscribers.description: Optional. Number as text. YouTube rounds subscriber counts, so this filter is approximate.

search_terms.description: Optional. Themes to find channels by, such as home espresso. Search results come from YouTube's channel search, up to the maximum per search below.

videos_to_check.description: Number as text, 0 to 10. Default 0, which is off. YouTube answered most video page reads with a sign in gate in testing, so this finds little and takes longer. Read only when no address has been found yet.

name: find_youtube_channel_emails
title: Find YouTube channel emails
